assets.notes: Hand-drawn elevation of a furnace setting with two human figures for scale. Annotations include SIDE WALL, POINT OF SUPPORT, 8' DOOR WITH WALL MOUNTED BUILDERS, AIR PREHEATER, GROUT, 8' FLOOR, DUCTWORK, TUBE REMOVAL AREA, and LIGHTING POLE. Caption block 'EXHIBIT 7-15 / Setting a Furnace / Elevation' sits to the upper right of the drawing.
